introduction_problem.text: Current methods grant broad privileges and therefore expose users to unnecessary execution risk.

shared_problem_method.text: Current methods grant broad privileges, while the proposed policy learns a task-conditioned permission boundary.

complete_result.text: On the held-out task, Baseline reaches 67.75% success while Proposed reaches 90.50% success.

formula_expansion: The unresolved reward formula proves that parameter alpha directly controls permission sparsity.
